payload.method: Deterministic readiness precedence over exact current SPO evidence state: reviewed physical source, exercised byte-canonical review adapter, missing diagnostic plan, accepted plan, then refused plan requiring repair. External evidence rank is context and never changes the lane.
payload.non_scalar_priority_policy: No opaque or additive score is emitted. Rows within one lane are deliberately unordered. Selection within a lane requires explicit review of safety value, calibrated machine-readable data availability, clock/reference/operator completeness, uncertainty, validity, quality, provenance, observability gates, independent validation, and producer capacity.

lane_definitions.selection_rule: Exact configuration already has reviewed physical-source custody but no qualified observation or physical phase.
Exact configuration has an exercised byte-canonical review adapter, but no physical source is qualified.
Architecture-only device project has no versioned diagnostic-plan object; build and publish the synthetic review contract first.
Device project has an exact, structurally accepted diagnostic plan but no configuration-specific physical producer intake.
Current exact producer object is structurally refused; repair owner or digest provenance before physical intake design.

configurations.topology: deuterated metal lattice under external driver
